attributes.title: Table Plan
attributes.lede: Seat twelve people. Drag them by the corner, because the card is also a form.

lesson.concept: The drag handle protects the rest of the card
lesson.why: The card disables its default drag listener, and a separate grip starts the drag controls. That leaves the note field and phone number usable as normal interactive content.
lesson.experiment: Edit a note, select a phone number, and then drag only by the corner. Compare the release distance under Slippery grip and Sticky grip.
lesson.pitfall: Starting a drag from every pointerdown steals caret placement and text selection from the form.
lesson.combine: Combine with reorder for editable lists whose rows move only from a deliberate handle.
